<!-- Source page: Castopod -->

[Castopod](https://github.com/ad-aures/castopod) is an open-source hosting platform made for podcasters who want to engage and interact with their audience.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-castopod).
